title: What fur can hold
hook: A layer can keep something important close to the skin.

knows: Animals have body structures and life histories.
doesNotKnow: Explain how air among hairs contributes to insulation.

misconception: A familiar animal feature always has the first explanation that comes to mind.
objective: Explain how air among hairs contributes to insulation.

claims.text: What helps an animal’s fur reduce heat loss in still, dry conditions? The cutaway highlights air pockets among the hairs above the skin. Air held in place can slow heat transfer; fur does not manufacture heat. Wetting, compression and moving air can change how well this layer insulates.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: OpenStax Biology 2e, animal temperature regulation, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e

claims.text: The diagram and its labels are schematic, not to scale and not an observation. Dry fur cross-section · schematic
A dry fleece traps air between fibers. What role can the trapped air play? Trapped air can help slow heat transfer through an insulating layer.
